claims.lived_anchors: All specific incidents come from the published Norwegian Getaway Aug 24-28 2026 logbook on this site: the duplicate photograph charge (third billing error of that week), the last-night specialty dinner that ran long during a billing dispute while luggage had to go out, the deliberately-late disembarkation, and the busier-than-usual last-morning main dining room. Each is already published with its own sourcing.
claims.generic_procedure: Folio availability (stateroom TV / line app / guest services print), tagged-vs-self-assist mechanics, tag-colour call groups and early cabin vacate are described generically as how cruise disembarkation commonly works. NO line-specific times, deadlines, tag colours, or policy numbers are stated, because those vary by line and ship and were not verified per-line for this piece.
claims.not_claimed: No claim about any line's specific luggage-out deadline, folio-close time, disembarkation start time, or dispute policy. No claim about typical or average anything. The disembarkation-is-orderly observation is framed as incentive-based reasoning plus one lived sailing, not as a measured fleet norm.
